topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I can't believe this. How could that ring, the one with the tiny diamonds and the inscription on the inside from when Grandmother and Grandfather were young, end up in a place like this? The clerk just stares at me, probably thinking I'm some kind of con artist. But I'm not. I know this ring. I've seen it a thousand times on her hand. I want it back, and now. I don't care what it costs. It shouldn’t even be here. It’s the principle of the thing. Something so personal, so sacred, reduced to a price tag. Just when I thought nothing else could surprise me, here we are.
